Name: Emily Male NSFW - With HD Portrait
Author: MarvelBrazilianBoy
Description:
This mod transforms our favorite crystal enthusiast and interpretive dance master, Emily, into her male NSFD version. It’s perfect for those who want to diversify the village bachelors or are looking for a new male romance option with that vibrant, spiritual, and "good vibes" energy that only Emily possesses.
[b]What this mod changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] Entirely new art for all dialogues, keeping that infectious smile and alternative look, now with masculine features.[/*]
[*][b]Sprites:[/b] The character model in the map (overworld) has been completely redesigned, including new animations for meditation and dance moments.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogues:[/b] Grammatical adjustments to reflect the gender change while preserving the eccentric personality and love for animals and gemstones.[/*]
[*][b]Heart Events:[/b] Classic scenes (like the fashion show or the dream dance) are visually adapted to fit the new character model.[/*]
[/list][b]How to install:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher , DDFCScaler, DialogueDisplayFramework, GenericModConfigMenu[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI and get ready to see Pelican Town with a whole new burst of color and positive energy![/*]
[/list]
